note: P4400 (Pro 31:29) — 'many women have done excellently, but you surpass them all.'

dims.v: pre-eminent worth — she excels even the excellent

the surpassing excellence of the woman of valour, who does excellently beyond even the many women who have done well — pre-eminent worth that stands above all comparison, the 'chayil' of 31:10 now crowned at the summit
the pre-eminent excellence that outdoes even the excellent

chayil (excellence/valour) — 'many women have done EXCELLENTLY, but you surpass them all' (31:29); the acrostic's climax of praise. Hers is not merely excellence but pre-eminence — she stands above even the many who have done well. The 'eshet chayil' crowned.
